ontology.note: Generic spatial-operation alignment; accepts point features, preserves missing coordinates as unknown; no dedicated activity-type receipt is added.

changes.description: Retired. Decomposed into the three steps it was always made of. Its candidate narrowing -- evidence tier at or above a minimum, service matching -- is now a candidateFilter knob on nearest, which is honest as a knob by the test experiment 107 derived: it leaves both ports and the output carrier untouched and changes only which candidates are eligible. Its nearest-neighbour search was already shared code, merged into src/nearest-neighbour.ts earlier the same day. Its proxy-minutes derivation is now the travel_time primitive, a widget rather than a knob because a minutes column changes every row for every consumer, and deliberately not a third value of the unit knob because minutes is a model and not a unit -- a straight-line distance walked at a constant speed, which this widget's own method string already admitted. The filter conditions reproduce this widget's eligibility exactly, verified against the real Old Naledi data at 1 of 122 graded facilities. Not replaceable by a single widget, so a saved workflow holding this node cannot be migrated automatically: it must be rebuilt as nearest with a candidate filter, then travel_time, then the access-review ruleset at 2.0.0. The Old Naledi example was rewired that way in the same commit.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently.
